sub_graphs.title: EIP-1571: Mining Session Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the session lifecycle in EthereumStratum/2.0.0 protocol between miner and pool

nodes.label: TCP Connection Established
nodes.description: Miner has opened TCP socket to pool server

nodes.label: Send mining.hello Request
nodes.description: Client sends hello with agent info, protocol version, host, port

nodes.label: Hello Response Received
nodes.description: Server responded with capabilities and session parameters

nodes.label: Send mining.subscribe Request
nodes.description: Client requests new session or attempts to resume previous session

nodes.label: Session Established
nodes.description: Server returned session ID, session is active

nodes.label: Send mining.authorize Request
nodes.description: Client authorizes workers with credentials

nodes.label: Workers Authorized
nodes.description: Workers have tokens and can receive mining jobs

nodes.label: Mining Active
nodes.description: Session fully established, mining jobs being processed

nodes.label: Send mining.bye Notification
nodes.description: Client or server initiates graceful disconnection

nodes.label: Session Terminated
nodes.description: Connection closed, session ended

edges.label: Miner opens TCP connection to pool

external_entities.name: Mining Client
external_entities.description: External mining software connecting to pool

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1571: Mining Work Distribution
sub_graphs.description: Models the work distribution and solution submission flow

nodes.label: Miner Awaiting Job
nodes.description: Miner is authorized and waiting for mining work

nodes.label: Receive mining.set Notification
nodes.description: Server broadcasts epoch, target difficulty, algorithm, extranonce

nodes.label: Mining Configuration Set
nodes.description: Miner has received mining parameters (persisted until next set)

nodes.label: Receive mining.notify Notification
nodes.description: Server sends job ID, block number, header hash, stale indicator

nodes.label: Mining Job Active
nodes.description: Miner is actively hashing on the received job

nodes.label: Compute Ethash PoW
nodes.description: Miner computes hashes trying to find valid nonce

nodes.label: Valid Nonce Found
nodes.description: Miner found a hash meeting target difficulty

nodes.label: Send mining.submit Request
nodes.description: Client submits solution with job ID, nonce, worker token

nodes.label: Submission Accepted
nodes.description: Server accepted the submitted solution

nodes.label: Submission Rejected
nodes.description: Server rejected the submission (stale, invalid, etc.)

nodes.label: Send mining.noop Notification
nodes.description: Client sends keepalive when no solutions found

external_entities.name: Mining Pool Server
external_entities.description: Pool server distributing work and collecting solutions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1571: Message Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for Stratum protocol messages

nodes.label: JSON Message Received
nodes.description: Raw JSON message received on TCP connection

nodes.label: Validate JSON Format
nodes.description: Verify message is valid JSON terminated with LF

nodes.label: Validate Message Type
nodes.description: Check if request (has id), response (has id+result/error), or notification (no id)

nodes.label: Validate Hex Formatting
nodes.description: Verify hex values are lowercase, no 0x prefix, minimal digits

nodes.label: Validate Worker Token
nodes.description: For submissions, verify worker token is authorized for session

nodes.label: Validate Job ID
nodes.description: Verify submitted job ID matches active job in session

nodes.label: Message Valid
nodes.description: Message passed all validation checks

nodes.label: Message Invalid
nodes.description: Message failed validation, error response sent

external_entities.name: Protocol Participant
external_entities.description: Client or server sending protocol messages

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1571: Error Handling and Connection Limits
sub_graphs.description: Models error classification and connection management

nodes.label: Error Condition Detected
nodes.description: Server detected an error in client message or behavior

nodes.label: Classify Error Code
nodes.description: Determine error category: 2xx (conditional), 3xx (auth), 4xx (syntax), 5xx (server)

nodes.label: Increment Error Counter
nodes.description: Track number of errors for this session

nodes.label: Send Error Response
nodes.description: Return JSON-RPC error with code and message

nodes.label: Under Error Limit
nodes.description: Error count below maxerrors threshold

nodes.label: Error Limit Exceeded
nodes.description: Too many errors, server will terminate connection

nodes.label: Idle Timeout Reached
nodes.description: No activity within timeout period

nodes.label: Force Disconnect Client
nodes.description: Server terminates connection due to errors or timeout

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1571: Session Resumption Logic
sub_graphs.description: Models the session resumption mechanism for recovering interrupted mining

nodes.label: Client Reconnecting
nodes.description: Client establishing new connection with previous session ID

nodes.label: Send Subscribe with Session ID
nodes.description: Client includes previous session ID in subscribe request

nodes.label: Lookup Session in Cache
nodes.description: Server checks if session ID exists in cache with valid state

nodes.label: Session Found in Cache
nodes.description: Server has cached session with jobs, extranonce, workers

nodes.label: Session Not Found/Expired
nodes.description: Session ID not in cache, new session required

nodes.label: Restore Session State
nodes.description: Server restores extranonce and active jobs from cache

nodes.label: Session Resumed
nodes.description: Same session ID returned, no re-auth needed

nodes.label: Create New Session
nodes.description: Server creates new session, full setup required

nodes.label: New Session Created
nodes.description: New session ID returned, client must re-authorize workers

external_entities.name: Reconnecting Miner
external_entities.description: Mining client attempting to resume previous session

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define the exact duration for session cache retention.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementation-defined timeout, likely tied to the 'timeout' parameter from hello exchange.

ambiguities.text: The term 'minimal significant digits' for hex values is not precisely defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume leading zeros should be stripped except for the single digit case (0 instead of empty).

ambiguities.text: Behavior when receiving gzip-compressed messages without prior negotiation is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume compressed messages are rejected with 4xx error if compression not negotiated in hello.

ambiguities.text: The specification states extranonce is 'limited to 6 bytes maximum' but doesn't explain the rationale.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 6 bytes allows sufficient worker segmentation (up to 2^48 unique extranonces) while leaving search space for miners.

implicit_assumptions.description: The mining pool server correctly distributes work and credits submitted solutions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Miners could be defrauded of rewards for valid work, or receive invalid jobs wasting compute resources.

implicit_assumptions.description: TCP connection is reliable with in-order delivery of messages.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Out-of-order or lost messages could cause protocol state desynchronization.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot impersonate a legitimate pool server without controlling the network path.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: MITM attacks could redirect hash power to attacker-controlled work, stealing mining rewards.

implicit_assumptions.description: Worker credentials are kept confidential between miner and pool.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Stolen credentials could allow unauthorized solution submission or session hijacking.
